Saathi programme

Serve your community. Grow your income.

Join 2000+ Saathis offering schemes, banking, remittance, jobs and digital services from their shop, kiosk or neighbourhood — with training, tools and support from Online Saathi.

Apply now Estimate earnings
SAATHI EARNINGS TODAY
50%

of Saathis earn ₹1,500–₹2,000 a month from platform services — on top of their existing business.

Saathi benefitsWhy Saathis join and how they earn
Saathi benefits

Why become a Saathi?

Earn on every service

Commission on each transaction, scheme application and referral you complete.

Free training

Hands-on onboarding, digital & financial literacy and ongoing mentorship.

One app, 50+ services

Banking, remittance, travel, bills, PAN and scheme tools in one dashboard.

Trusted identity

A verified Saathi ID and branding that builds credibility in your area.

More footfall

New services bring new customers to your existing shop or kiosk.

Backed by a team

Helpline, partner relationship managers and escalation support.

Respect in your community

Be the person neighbours trust for help with forms, money and rights.

Room to grow

Add specialisations as you gain experience and customers.

How Saathis earn

One counter. Many ways to earn.

Every service a customer needs becomes an earning opportunity for you.

BANKING

Cash & transfers

AEPS withdrawals, money transfer and Indo-Nepal remittance.

SCHEMES

Assisted applications

Registration and enrolment for welfare schemes and insurance.

JOBS

Referrals

Connect workers to verified employers through Safe Jobs Connect.

PAYMENTS

Everyday services

PAN, travel bookings, recharges and bill payments.

Specialisations

Choose your Saathi path

Bank Mitra Saathi

AEPS cash, account services and remittance for your area.

Bima Mitra Saathi

Micro-insurance awareness and enrolment for families.

Rojgar Mitra Saathi

Job referrals, worker registration and placement support.

Yojana Mitra Saathi

Scheme discovery, documents and applications.

Use cases

Who becomes a Saathi?

Kirana shop owner

Adds services to an existing shop
Before

Steady shop, but limited income and customers only for groceries.

As a Saathi

Offers AEPS cash, remittance and bill payments at the counter.

Result

Extra monthly commission and more footfall for the shop.

Self-help group member

Becomes a Bima Mitra Saathi
Before

Trusted in her village, but no independent income.

As a Saathi

Explains and enrols families in insurance and welfare schemes.

Result

Her own earnings, and protected families in her community.

Educated youth in a district

Becomes a Rojgar & Yojana Mitra
Before

Smartphone skills, but few local job options.

As a Saathi

Registers workers, runs scheme camps and makes job referrals.

Result

A local livelihood, and a path to grow as a field leader.

Cyber café operator

Upgrades to a full service point
Before

Printing and form-filling only, low margins.

As a Saathi

Adds PAN, travel, remittance and banking to the menu.

Result

More services per customer and repeat visits.

Illustrative use cases based on how Saathis work today.

04
Become a SaathiApply in two minutes
Who can apply

Ideal Saathis

  • Shop owners, kiosk and cyber-café operators
  • Community volunteers and SHG members
  • Youth with basic smartphone skills
  • Anyone trusted in their neighbourhood or worker community
Flexible Saathi plans — monthly, 6-monthly and yearly — are shared during onboarding.
Do I need a shop?

No. A shop helps, but many Saathis serve their community from home or in the field.

What do I need to start?

A smartphone, basic KYC documents and the willingness to help people. We provide training and the app.

How soon can I start earning?

As soon as you complete verification and training and your Saathi ID is activated.

Saathi application
